groups.sentence: Instructors teach students foundational skills without AI first, then allow or introduce AI once those basics are mastered.
Instructors allow AI such as tutoring or programming help in advanced courses, with fewer AI restrictions at higher course levels.
Instructors may set AI use as excluded or permitted at different stages of an assignment, which scaffolding helps clarify.
Students use AI only after they have practiced or mastered the essential skills, having first worked without it.
Students do not use AI during the peer review stage or on the final draft.
